highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.157.0 release corrects transformed GPU geometry, Ganesh empty flushes, and Graphite clip-stack capacity handling.
highlights_body: The native corrections retain Skia m157 without changing managed APIs or generated bindings.

bullets.detail: Corrects mixed matrix-axis coefficients when transforming rounded-rectangle radii and ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke widths. Corner radii are clamped to half the transformed bounds to prevent overlap.
Advances draw tokens and catches up flush tokens after empty flushes so atlas work scheduled during one flush is not treated as pending later.

Counts clip elements that still need recording without double-counting recorded clips, and accepts passes exactly at capacity. Draws whose full effective clip stack cannot fit in a fresh pass are warned about and skipped instead of exceeding render-step capacity.
